title: A.T.L.A.S. — Area Tactical Line-of-sight Awareness System
description: Generic, any-system zone-based fog of war: trace rooms, wire doors, set In/Out/Through line-of-sight, and tokens hide/reveal live per-player as they move. Plus stackable GM area EFFECTS (web/fire/smoke) with room tints and per-effect LOS writes. (Extracted from the Conan area tool — see DC20/AREA-MODULE-PLAN.md.)
